title: How to show your Gratitude to God
Sanctuary Sunday School Class Stan King
Watch Your Words
summary: From the book Only God Can Change A Heart Chapter 16. Pastor Timothy Bass delivers a lesson on the power of words, emphasizing the importance of speaking with grace and truth. He discusses avoiding unwholesome talk like gossip and criticism, and instead focusing on compassionate communication, forgiveness, and active listening. The sermon includes scripture references and personal anecdotes, concluding with a reflective prayer. The service also features prayer requests, personal testimonies, and an interactive Bible quiz
